checklist_items_creation_verifier.evidence: the request lists three items but fixes no order of creation, so tying 'Download Policy PDF' to checklist_id 91, 'Compare with current version' to 92 and 'Update Case Worknotes' to 93 tests sequence position; each item is selected by task 150 and its description instead, and the total of three rows on the task is kept

combined_data_integrity_verifier.evidence: a conjunction of the task, checklist and survey-instance checks; its checklist part pairs each description with a fixed checklist_id (91, 92, 93) although the request fixes no creation order, so the items are selected by task and description instead; every other part is carried unchanged

referential_integrity_verifier.evidence: a conjunction of foreign-key checks over the new task, items and survey instance; its checklist part names the items by checklist_id 91 to 93, which only sequence position fixes, so the items are selected by task 150 and description instead; the task's parent case and group and the instance's survey, user and task are carried unchanged

notes:
disagreement: value: the source of the three-item total on task 150: one pass names the item and combined checks, the other also the referential check; kept all three, since the referential check's checklist part, with its sequence-fixed ids dropped, counts the three items on task 150.
The two passes otherwise agree on every requirement, cell and value (task 150 on case 1 for group 4, three items selected by task and description, survey instance 26 of survey 1 for user 2 on task 150, and the stay that no other survey is linked to the task) and on all five dispositions.
The request's opening ('reviewing the inquiry', 'needs immediate action', 'locate the HR Service Desk Group that's currently assigned') asks for no change: the case is read, not altered, and no listed tool updates hr_case, so it has no requirement.
The policy's rule that a task be assigned to an active user of its assignment group is not tested: the request names only the group, which has two active members (users 15 and 22), nothing picks one, and every ready task in the seed has no assigned user, so assigned_to is left open.
Booleans are compared with true and false, which the seed stores as 1 and 0.
